headline: Power Backup for Tom Green County Homes
summary: Tom Green County has a low outlook for long power outages. Homes see a long outage about once every 9 years based on 8 years of records since 2018. In February 2021, 49% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth waited about 70 hours. In May 2019, 48% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth waited about 13 hours. For a home with gas heat and a larger footprint, one Core lasts about 15 hours in August. One Core lasts about 38 hours in November. Two Cores last about 23 hours in August. 2 Cores cover 96% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
